condition: When bundled with Parcel/Plasmo (before Parcel 2.14.2), format with long tokens like 'p' or formatRelative throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'p')" because the longFormatters module gets tree-shaken out of the bundle.
workaround: Import formatters and longFormatters from date-fns and reference them (e.g. const FORCE_BUNDLE = [formatters, longFormatters]), or upgrade Parcel to 2.14.2 or later.
